jobs.description_text: Natera is hiring a Senior Director to lead the research, development and clinical translation of AI and computational algorithms for oncology diagnostics, from research prioritization through validation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring. Natera’s longitudinal oncology data resources span tumor genomics, ctDNA, transcriptomics, pathology images, and clinical outcomes, creating opportunities to develop and validate models across molecular, imaging, and clinical data. You will lead an established algorithm team, develop its technical and leadership capabilities, and recruit talent aligned with the product roadmap.
